environment.description: Same Ktor microservice deployed in a Kubernetes pod on GKE with a custom AppArmor profile loaded via annotation 'container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/authsvc=localhost/authsvc-restricted'. The profile (installed on all nodes via DaemonSet) denies all file read/write operations except to /tmp/** and /proc/self/**, using 'deny /etc/** rwklx,' and 'deny /var/** rwklx,' rules. The pod also has a seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault) applied. An Istio sidecar proxy with outlier detection (consecutive5xxLimit: 3, interval: 10s) sits in front of the service, and the mesh-level retry policy adds variable latency (25-150ms jitter) to all responses via an EnvoyFilter fault injection configuration with fixed_delay applied uniformly to the /api/v1/authenticate path.

config.apparmor_rules: deny /etc/** rwklx, deny /var/** rwklx, allow /tmp/** rw, allow /proc/self/** r
